items.note: The prompt never says the product is a B2B note-taking app. It only says "this product" and talks about generic "resources".
The prompt mentions a team reviewing the PRD before engineering starts, but it never names the engineering and design leads as readers or says this is for a kickoff.
The v1 scope isn't stated. Creating a workspace, inviting members by email and shared notes are never named. The prompt only speaks generally about sharing and managing resources.
The prompt lists roles as an interview topic to ask about. It doesn't say v1 has only admin and member.
Billing changes, SSO and guest access are not listed as out of scope. The prompt even asks for a Billing and limits section, while the user wants billing changes excluded.
The success metric is left as an interview topic. The prompt never states the target of 20% of paid accounts creating a workspace within 60 days.
The prompt asks for ten sections and a document that takes about 10 minutes to read. That is clearly longer than the user's limit of about 2 pages.
Migration of existing shared notes isn't marked as an open question. Migration of individual accounts is only an interview topic, and the prompt asks for a section on data model and migration impact.

invented: Nothing is approved to build yet (used as the reason for documentation only)
The PRD is for review before any engineering starts
Workspaces are framed as replacing a model where each user works in an individual account and shares/manages generic 'resources'
Billing and limits may apply to workspaces (a billing section is requested even though the user puts billing changes out of scope)
